name: Big 4 Tribute Festival
description: tribute night to Metallica, Slayer, Megadeth and Anthrax
details: Tribute night to the Big 4 of thrash metal: Metallica, Slayer, Megadeth and Anthrax tribute bands on one bill. As of 7 Nov the 7er Club calendar lists both the Saturday 14 Nov show and the extra show (Zusatzkonzert) on Friday 13 Nov as sold out (ausverkauft); doors 18:00, start 19:00 both days. Box office only if returns come up.
note: both days sold out (extra date Fri 13 Nov too); mixed bill incl. a Metallica tribute
